title: File view
parallelHint: How many files are transferred at once. This helps most with many small files, because the wait for the server's reply is shared; a single large file fills the line on its own anyway. Applies to all connections in all workspaces.
editorHint: The full path to the program. Empty means: the program the system would open the file with anyway.
argumentsHint: If an editor is set, WireTerm starts it itself and ends the editing as soon as it closes — the row above then disappears on its own. For that, though, the editor has to open a window of its own instead of passing the file to one that is already open and quitting right away. That is exactly what the arguments are for: {notepad} for Notepad++, {vscode} for VS Code. The file path is appended; where it has to go elsewhere, write {file}.
